# Audio credits

- Engine loop: Kenney, CC0. https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-Racing/blob/main/audio/engine.ogg
- Tire skid: Landeplage, CC0, distributed by Kenney. https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-Racing/blob/main/audio/skid.ogg
- Boost, pass, crash and takedown cues: Earshot sound bank, rendered with `earshot kit`; reproducible kit and lockfile included.
- Barrier scrape: original filtered noise transient, source in scripts/make_audio.py.

The first synthesized engine and tire pass was rejected after Earshot listening identified hum/static. The shipped loops use the CC0 recordings above, normalized to leave headroom. Earshot descriptions and match checks document the listening pass.
- Quiet background music: original deterministic electro arcade loop, composed in scripts/make_music.py. No sampled musical material.
